title: Tokens swapped through a decentralised exchange
summary: The wallet swaps one token for another through a contract on the same chain, in 1 to 3 swaps. The tokens are easier to launder after the swap.

basis.note: No source read for this design publishes how often a screening tool loses the link at this method. The value is an assumption and means that the trail is lost in 10 cases in 100.

parties.label: the wallet that holds the funds
a new wallet that receives the other token

steps.say: The wallet sends the funds to the exchange contract in 1 to 3 swaps.

basis.note: The report describes a self-custody wallet that swaps tokens on a decentralised exchange. The counts, the sizes and the waits are assumed.

steps.say: The contract pays the other token to a new wallet for each swap.

basis.note: The report describes swaps into assets that are easier to launder. The wait of 1 to 30 minutes is assumed, and the swap fee is not modelled.
